categories_thin: Independent hotels/motels: only two independents could be tied to the zone (Circle Motor Lodge, Gallery Motel), both with South Amboy postal addresses; the third Sayreville-licensed motel, Knights Inn Parkway, is a chain and excluded.

Tutoring and test prep: the market is dominated by franchise learning centres (Kumon, Mathnasium, JEI, Tutor Doctor, Genie Academy), which are excluded; no clearly independent centre could be confirmed on an opened page.
Art schools and pottery studios: none located inside Sayreville or Parlin in searches; nearest results were in Morganville, Highland Park and Edison.
Picture framing: no framing shop in the zone surfaced; Yellow Pages results were Edison and Milltown businesses.
Jewelry, music and bikes: only two jewelers (Priscilla Jewelry, More's Jewelry), one instrument shop and two bike/sporting-goods shops could be sourced, matching the small downtown retail base.
Photography: mostly single-operator businesses with no published studio address, so only one Parlin-based studio is included.
caveats: Removed this revision: All Brands Furniture (605 New Brunswick Ave is Perth Amboy and it is a four-store NJ chain), Elwir's Furniture (224 Smith St is Perth Amboy), Debra Lippmann Collection (single bulk listing, unconfirmable) and Roberts Cleaners (reported closed in 2024 after a vehicle struck the building, with no source showing a reopening).

Town rule applied to Parlin: any address in the Parlin 08859 zip is labelled 'Parlin' because Parlin straddles the Sayreville/Old Bridge line; the municipal boundary for each such row is marked unconfirmed rather than guessed. Rows affected include Priscilla Jewelry, Paul's Toy Room, Avantika Creations, Childrenswear Centre, Broadway Computer Repair, Atlantic Belt & Industrial, Kidzland and the Bordentown Ave / Washington Rd dry cleaners.

Gallery Motel's parcel is placed in Sayreville by the borough's own 2025 tax-appeal resolution; Circle Motor Lodge only holds a Sayreville motel licence while publishing a South Amboy address, so its zone membership rests on inference from licensing, not on an address confirmation.

Five entries are marked 'NEEDS VERIFICATION' (Tech Train, Furniture to Go, Furniture & Bathroom Depot, Fiona's Find, Childrenswear Centre): each rests on one stale or conflicting directory and should be cold-verified before any outreach.

Yellow Pages, Cylex, Manta, Localsolution, Findglocal, BBB and several company sites block automated loads (403 / Cloudflare / certificate errors) from this environment, so some entries rest on search-result snippets naming those listings rather than on an opened directory page.

Bulk-directory entries (us-business.info Yellow Pages data, NJ Business Directory) are often stale and skew toward home-based or defunct firms; these are flagged as single-directory or bulk in active_evidence and should be verified first.
Home-based businesses with residential street addresses were excluded or had the street address withheld (Busy Bee Flowers, Fisher Bros Logistics) for privacy.

Chains and franchises found and excluded: Knights Inn Parkway (Sayreville-licensed but a Wyndham brand), Lightbridge Academy, The Learning Experience, Goddard School, Kumon, JEI, Mathnasium, Tutor Doctor, Genie Academy, Mattress Firm, Petco, Sally Beauty, Extended Stay America, Extra Space Storage, CubeSmart, The UPS Store, Numotion, Starland Ballroom (AEG), CMC Steel and Sabert (large plants).
Group C trades and group A professional listings that appeared in the same directories were skipped because this task covers group D only.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API requests still time out; the only OSM-derived record used came via a Mapcarta mirror page.

The Sayreville borough website publishes council resolutions but no machine-readable business directory or licensed-business list; the motel-licence resolution was usable but there is no equivalent for retail or services.
No Sayreville/Parlin chamber of commerce or downtown BID member directory is published online; the Middlesex County regional chamber directory was not reachable.
Google Maps in this browser returned only a limited result view per query, so map-based enumeration is shallow; radius-based map results were not used for zone membership this revision.
BBB, Manta and Yellow Pages category pages still cannot be opened directly, limiting verification of many single-directory entries.
The bulk Yellow Pages-derived directory was only readable for names starting A-F, so G-Z bulk listings for Sayreville were not swept.

Atlantic Belt & Industrial's and Saltywater Tackle's own contact pages would not load (certificate / 403 errors), so their phone or address facts rest on search-returned page content rather than an opened page; N&T Pawlidays Inn publishes no street address on the pages reachable here.
